issues.title: Parallel and cached sanctuary haze can lose the current level atmosphere policy during integration
issues.status: FIXED_SOURCE_PARITY_VERIFIED; physical renderer acceptance remains separate
issues.affected: SafeAreaHaze and LevelAtmosphere integration; parallel scanlines and held-clock sanctuary frames
issues.symptom: The saved atmosphere feature depended on caller-thread projection context, while newer main sanctuary work dispatched scanlines to worker threads and retained exact ray/opacity/column caches. A naive merge could omit the active fog policy on those workers or preserve stale shading after a held-clock weather change.
issues.cause: Thread-local atmosphere lookup is not an authoritative policy transfer across the parallel raster lanes and cannot be replaced by a cached visual result.
issues.action: Capture the immutable LevelAtmosphere.Policy on the calling frame and pass it explicitly into every parallel/cached haze shading path. Retain existing ray, opacity and column caching and the live occlusion/depth tests; do not reduce player/ghost simulation cadence.
issues.evidence: development/levels/rebuild/verification/map-integration-2026-11-26/checks/SafeAreaHazeColumnsTest.log: assertions-enabled Java17 PASS for moving/held six-frame RGB/depth parity, occlusion, clock/resize behavior, exact columns, held-same-clock atmosphere changes and the parallel path above96,000 pixels. Production source files: src/main/java/org/beckenburg/SafeAreaHaze.java and LevelAtmosphere.java; exact file digests in development/levels/rebuild/verification/map-integration-2026-11-26/checks/source-files-sha256.json.
issues.older_maps: Review each map atmosphere and refuge in the actual renderer. This local parity regression preserves shared behavior but does not establish physical GPU frame-time gains, whole-map lighting acceptance or complete-map status.

issues.title: Catalogue render smoke uses unsupported House camera on other maps and masks assertions during cleanup
issues.symptom: The catalogue smoke falsely rejected MV Saint Elara after drawing from SceneRenderer default House coordinates. Cleanup could also mask the real assertion with DirectoryNotEmptyException when renderer preferences populated its temporary home.
issues.cause: The test instantiated SceneRenderer without applying each map’s authored coordinates or elevation, and deleted only the temporary directory root. Elara default feet (20.5,0,27.5) have room -1 and are unsupported.
issues.action: Preserve recursive cleanup of the test-owned home; select a supported, correctly owned authored room spawn; aim at a real room opening (or authored far boundary); set feet and eye elevation. Keep the >20 distinct-pixel check and additionally require physical geometry to cover more than 5% of the framebuffer. Log every tested site’s camera and coverage.
issues.older_maps: The same supported-camera and geometry-depth assertions apply to every public built-in location, including original layouts; USER remains unavailable unless explicitly selected. This is a harness correction, not a gameplay geometry or renderer change.
issues.regression_check: Java 17.0.21.1+2 with -Xmx1024m passes SiteSelectionTest for all 28 public sources in 20.01 seconds. Every camera is supported and owned by its selected room; every frame exceeds 20 colours and 5% physical-depth coverage (actual minima: 39 colours and 44,719 of 64,000 pixels). Elara unchanged source: unsupported House camera produced 16 colours; authored Galley camera produced 49 colours and 63,867 physical pixels. USER selection and Solo/LAN roster parity remain checked. Earlier externally killed runs and the 768 MB heap-limited 27/28 run are retained as partial evidence, not passes.

issues.title: Sparse gallery generation silently drops committed captures and their animation attachments
issues.affected: Development gallery generation in sparse or partial checkouts; preserved main and roster-candidate capture history
issues.symptom: The gallery builder skipped any tracked PNG absent from the working tree and discovered animation attachments only through filesystem existence. The integration contains 15,302 staged historical PNG paths, so regenerating from the sparse checkout could erase most recorded evidence from the index even though the images remain committed.
issues.cause: The builder treated hydration as source membership and had no path-and-blob-bound reuse of already committed metadata. It could also pair staged thumbnails with unrelated untracked video files.
issues.action: Enumerate selected Git paths; snapshot actual HEAD and MERGE_HEAD commits; reuse only dimensions, byte counts and SHA-256 when the exact current staged blob matches the same parent tree path and any explicit cached git_blob_sha. Recompute labels from current source rules. Hash actual new/changed bytes, fall back to the exact Git blob, and fail explicitly if it is unavailable. Preserve tracked video attachments, honor staged-only source selection, and emit schema v2 git_blob_sha identities. Read a missing sparse HTML template from the staged Git object.
issues.evidence: tools/build_development_gallery.py. Isolated fixture regressions cover two-parent preservation, changed PNG/video blobs, same-blob/new-path mismatch, invalid and unstaged working copies, staged deletions, untracked attachment filtering, missing blob failure without partial outputs, false cached identity, conflicting parent metadata, template fallback, deterministic regeneration and same-size pixel-mutation --check failure. Final staged generation and --check retained 15,311 PNGs (15,302 staged history plus nine integration diagnostics); 170 uncached historical paths required 85 unique actual blob hashes. New capture labels explicitly identify headless software SceneRenderer diagnostics, including the preserved first frame of the 450 ms door animation. Inputs HEAD 9f1cf5e2b5535b2ded46eba07d55c78f61211775 and MERGE_HEAD d9f706f44984aaf05cadaf0911eb058880056bb2. No fresh whole-map or physical-hardware acceptance follows from indexing. Final receipt: development/levels/rebuild/verification/map-integration-2026-11-26/checks/gallery-verification.json.
issues.older_maps: Preserve both branches' source capture history and correct native, rejected, synthetic and runtime labels. Metadata reuse proves identity continuity with its committed parent, not a fresh image, visual or gameplay review. After staging any capture changes, rerun --tracked-only and --tracked-only --check on the final checkpoint.

issues.title: Historical map review harnesses expect retired photo, identification and ritual-duration contracts
issues.status: PARTIALLY FIXED verification harnesses: House photo negatives and eight identification responses corrected; Northwatch current packaged case passes; seven sibling duration and replay follow-ups remain open. No production gameplay defect established.
issues.affected: HouseEncounterSessionTest and the Northwatch, Greywater, Mine, Blackwater, Monastery, Red Mesa, Mourning Marsh and Asylum continuous investigation review tools.
issues.symptom: The merged House encounter test rejected a successful ordinary toy-photo exposure. Northwatch first timed out after 39.12 seconds waiting for the retired ENTITY IDENTIFIED WRAITH response despite reaching the archive and receiving witnessed EMF. After correcting that expectation, its complete route reached and started the laboratory rite but the harness timed out after only 15 seconds, at 129.43 seconds total. The current ordinary banishment requires 900 host ticks / 90 seconds. All seven sibling review tools also retain 15-second result waits.
issues.cause: Saved candidate verification code predates newer main semantics: successful shutter operation is separate from a manual notebook claim and an optically qualified photo reward; identification acknowledges an investigator hypothesis without confirming correctness; identity-mode rites require 750/900/1050 ordinary 100 ms ticks rather than finishing within the historical short waits. These failures do not establish broken map geometry, incorrect photo rewards or failed host rites.
issues.action: Preserve production behavior. HouseEncounterSessionTest now checks successful film use, no automatic evidence, and zero photo reward even after a mistaken manual toy-photo claim. Update the eight historical case tools to require the exact ENTITY HYPOTHESIS RECORDED response while retaining witness, route, wrong-location, rite, result and payout checks. Northwatch derives its result deadline from the live mission requiredRitualTicks() at the unchanged ordinary 100 ms clock plus a 15-second delivery margin; the real 900-tick rite and outer 660-second cap remain. Leave the other seven duration repairs and current-source replays explicitly open.

issues.title: House porch capture labels the initial door-animation pose as an open door

issues.symptom: The original capture issued the open command and rendered immediately during the450ms animation. Its open-door filename could therefore describe the initial pose rather than the real settled leaf.
issues.cause: The capture fixture assumed an accepted state command made visual animation complete in the same frame; it did not verify a settled render pose or different open/closed pixels.
issues.action: Wait for the actual settled door pose before capturing and assert that the open/closed rendered pixels differ. Preserve the original image as diagnostic-first-frame-after-open-command.png, explicitly labeled as an initial animation diagnostic. Do not change production door geometry or timing to satisfy the capture.
